key_insight: ASPIS-Net combines acoustic and electrical signals with physics-informed learning to classify CMT weld penetration states and derive interpretable equations.
engineering_relevance: Noise-aware, interpretable weld monitoring could support quality assurance and structural reliability assessment of critical welded joints.
method: Dual-branch network learns acoustic and electrical signal features.
Adaptive gated fusion suppresses noise while preserving relevant features.
Symbolic regression translates learned representations into explicit equations linked to welding thermodynamics.
evidence_signal: On 5,000 synchronized samples covering four penetration states, ASPIS-Net achieved 99.36% classification accuracy and 75.59% Macro-F1 under 0 dB composite noise.
watch_item: Generalization to other welding setups and independent validation of the inferred physical equations remain unestablished in the abstract.
paper_title: Physics-informed multi-sensor fusion framework for predicting weld penetration state and mechanistic discovery in CMT welding
